title: ChatCompletionStreamResponse

id.title: Id
id.description: A unique identifier for the chat completion.

object.title: Object
object.description: The object type, always `chat.completion` or `chat.completion.chunk` for streaming.

created.title: Created
created.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the completion was created.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model used for the completion.

choices.title: Choices
choices.description: A list of chat completion choices.

usage.description: Token usage statistics for the request. Only present when streaming with `stream_options.include_usage: true`.

description: A chat completion response returned by the model.
